changelog.en: New: the details of an add-on show what it connects to: the provider with a link to its website, the online services and what is sent to them, or that it works offline.
changelog.de: Neu: Die Details eines Add-ons zeigen, womit es sich verbindet: den Anbieter mit Link zu seiner Website, die Online-Dienste und was an sie übertragen wird, oder dass es offline arbeitet.
changelog.fr: Nouveau : les détails d'un module indiquent à quoi il se connecte : le fournisseur avec un lien vers son site web, les services en ligne et ce qui leur est transmis, ou qu'il fonctionne hors ligne.
changelog.it: Novità: i dettagli di un componente aggiuntivo mostrano a cosa si connette: il fornitore con un link al suo sito web, i servizi online e cosa viene loro trasmesso, oppure che funziona offline.
changelog.es: Novedad: los detalles de un complemento muestran a qué se conecta: el proveedor con un enlace a su sitio web, los servicios en línea y lo que se les transmite, o que funciona sin conexión.
changelog.nl: Nieuw: de details van een add-on tonen waarmee deze verbinding maakt: de aanbieder met een link naar zijn website, de onlinediensten en wat ernaar wordt verstuurd, of dat de add-on offline werkt.
changelog.pt: Novidade: os detalhes de um suplemento mostram a que se liga: o fornecedor com uma ligação para o seu site, os serviços online e o que lhes é transmitido, ou que funciona offline.
changelog.da: Nyt: Detaljerne for et tilføjelsesprogram viser, hvad det forbinder til: udbyderen med et link til dens websted, onlinetjenesterne og hvad der sendes til dem, eller at det fungerer offline.
changelog.fi: Uutta: lisäosan tiedot kertovat, mihin se muodostaa yhteyden: tarjoaja ja linkki sen verkkosivustolle, verkkopalvelut ja mitä niille lähetetään, tai että lisäosa toimii offline-tilassa.
changelog.nb: Nytt: Detaljene for et tillegg viser hva det kobler til: leverandøren med lenke til nettstedet, nettjenestene og hva som sendes til dem, eller at det fungerer frakoblet.
changelog.sv: Nytt: Detaljerna för ett tillägg visar vad det ansluter till: leverantören med en länk till webbplatsen, onlinetjänsterna och vad som skickas till dem, eller att det fungerar offline.
changelog.pl: Nowość: szczegóły dodatku pokazują, z czym się łączy: dostawcę z linkiem do jego witryny, usługi online i to, co jest do nich przesyłane, albo że działa offline.
changelog.cs: Novinka: podrobnosti doplňku ukazují, k čemu se připojuje: poskytovatele s odkazem na jeho web, online služby a co se jim předává, nebo že funguje offline.
changelog.hu: Újdonság: a bővítmény részletei megmutatják, mihez csatlakozik: a szolgáltatót a webhelyére mutató hivatkozással, az online szolgáltatásokat és azt, hogy mi kerül hozzájuk, vagy hogy offline működik.
changelog.ru: Новое: в сведениях о надстройке показано, к чему она подключается: поставщик со ссылкой на его веб-сайт, онлайн-службы и то, что им передается, или что она работает автономно.
changelog.tr: Yeni: Bir eklentinin ayrıntıları neye bağlandığını gösterir: web sitesi bağlantısıyla sağlayıcı, çevrimiçi hizmetler ve onlara ne gönderildiği ya da çevrimdışı çalıştığı.
changelog.zh-Hans: 新增：加载项详细信息会显示它连接到哪里：提供商及其网站链接、在线服务以及发送给它们的内容，或者说明它离线工作。
changelog.zh-Hant: 新增：增益集詳細資訊會顯示它連線到哪裡：提供者及其網站連結、線上服務以及傳送給它們的內容，或說明它離線運作。
changelog.ja: 新機能: アドオンの詳細に接続先が表示されるようになりました。提供者とその Web サイトへのリンク、オンライン サービスと送信される内容、またはオフラインで動作することが分かります。
changelog.ko: 새로운 기능: 추가 기능 세부 정보에 연결 대상이 표시됩니다. 제공업체와 웹사이트 링크, 온라인 서비스와 전송되는 내용 또는 오프라인으로 작동한다는 사실을 확인할 수 있습니다.
changelog.ar: جديد: تعرض تفاصيل الوظيفة الإضافية ما تتصل به: المزوّد مع رابط إلى موقعه، والخدمات عبر الإنترنت وما يُرسل إليها، أو أنها تعمل دون اتصال.

complianceAudit.method: Checked all #include directives and linker inputs of PluginStore.vcxproj (Windows SDK incl. BCrypt/Crypt32 for SHA-256 and the ECDSA signature check, MFC/ATL, Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK only), the bundled UILayout and icon files (own work, icons drawn by client/res/make_icons.py) and the package contents. One third-party component: the Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader (BSD-3-Clause), linked into PluginStore.zxt; its NOTICE lists only BSD-licensed .NET tooling that is not used. The bundled MSI is built with the WiX Toolset v3 (build tool; its standard WixUI dialog resources are part of the installer). No credentials, personal data or third-party trademarks in the package. The only network service is the configured Add-on Store server (HTTPS). Since 1.9.8 the setup shows, on a Power PDF licensed with a serial number, a dialog whose button "Request a quote" opens Tungsten Automation's public quote page in the default browser (only on that click, never in silent installs); the setup itself sends nothing. The MSI also installs AddonStoreLink.exe (own code, no network access), which handles addonstore:// links by passing a validated package id to the client.

externalServices.name: Add-on Store server (configurable; default addon.power-pdf.de, Azure address ppdf-store.azurewebsites.net)
externalServices.data: Catalog, search and package downloads; sends the Power PDF UI language, the beta channel flag and, only when the user or IT entered one, the customer code of a delivery (X-Customer-Code header). The catalog is also read once in the background about 15 seconds after Power PDF starts and after the store window closes, to show the update badge (IT can switch this off with the policy UpdateBadge = 0). No personal data, no documents.

externalServices.name: Tungsten Automation quote page (setup only, serial-number Power PDF)
externalServices.data: None from the setup: the button opens the public page in the default browser (tungstenautomation.de for German, .fr for French, .com otherwise); the browser then talks to that website as with any link.

elevation.reason: Installing, updating and removing add-ons writes to Power PDF's Plug-Ins folder in Program Files: one PowerShell step runs elevated after the UAC prompt, only when the user installs, updates or removes an add-on (the self-update starts msiexec the same way).
